newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Lagoven sees output rising over 10 yrs.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Lagoven sees output rising over 10 yrs.

text.p: Venezuelan oil company Lagoven expects its production capacity to rise 58 percent to 2.1 million barrels per day (bpd) by 2006, the company said.
Lagoven, the largest of state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela's (PDVSA) three main subsidiaries, had a production capacity of 1.33 million bpd at the end of 1996.
The rise in output capacity will come from traditional areas, operating contracts with private partners in marginal fields and joint ventures in the Orinoco Tar Belt, Lagoven said in a release.
During the same 10-year period liquid natural gas output will more than double from 52,000 bpd to 112,000 bpd, it added.
Under the company's 10-year business plan, Lagoven and its private partners will invest more than $15 billion.
